map.公式里灰缝算多大？: How big is the joint in the formula?
map.常用 10mm。灰缝越大单砖覆盖面积越小、用砖越多；本工具按你输入灰缝计算。: Commonly 10mm. Larger joints reduce per-brick coverage and raise count; this tool uses your input joint.

map.为什么实际总比算的多？: Why is actual always more than calculated?
